['Penny-Markt GmbH '].company_description: Penny-Markt GmbH, operating in several European countries, is a leading discount store chain with a focus on offering fresh, top-quality produce and locally sourced products where possible. The company is actively involved in political discussions related to wholesale/retail trade, food, sustainability, business, digitalization, and tourism.

['Strabag AG '].company_description: STRABAG SE is an Austrian construction company that is the largest construction company in Austria and one of the largest in Europe. It operates in Austria, Germany, Central, Eastern, and South-East Europe, as well as in selected markets in Western Europe, the Arabian Peninsula, Canada, Chile, China, and India. The company is involved in construction projects and operates subsidiaries in various countries.
